† 1. वज् वज्, i. 1, Par. To go.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. vagari.

= Rigv. iii. 62, 8.
 2. † To prepare the way.
 3. † (rather a denomin. derived from वाज), To trim or feather an arrow.
 4. † To go.
 --Cf. Lat. vegere and augere, probably vigor, vigere; ὑγιής; O.H.G. auhôn; A.S. eacan, see वक्ष्; probably also A.S. wacor, cf. Icel. vakr; A.S. wácian.

; Hit. ii. d. 158.

 6. Sour gruel.
 7. Harsh language.
 8. A child or pupil.

वज्र-कपाट + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Having doors of diamond, Bhāg.

वज्रकीलाय, a denomin. derived from वज्र-कील with य, Ātm. To act like a thunderbolt.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. वज्रकीलयित, Struck as by thunderbolts, Utt.
वज्र-धर, and वज्रभृत् वज्र-भृ + त्, m. Indra,
वज्र + मय, adj., f. यी, Hard, adamantine, Utt.
वज्रिन्, i. e. वज्र + इन्, m. Indra, Vikr. d. 5.

वाज, i. e. वज् + अ,
 I. m. and n. A wing (see comp.).
 II. m.
 1. Food, sacrificial food,

. The feather of an arrow.
 5. Sound.
 III. n.
 1. Clarified butter.

. The acidulous mixture of ground meal and water left to ferment.
 --Comp.
